raw_text: A group called CyberVandals is claiming to have breached ISRO's telemetry infrastructure. Posting screenshots that appear to show internal dashboards. Worth monitoring but the screenshots look suspicious — the UI elements are inconsistent with actual ISRO ISTRAC systems. The claimed 2.3 TB exfil in a single session would also require bandwidth that should trigger IDS alerts. Waiting for CERT-In response.
